steps.note: Cream added to whey makes the firmer, fattier fløtemysost.
It is boiled for several hours until the water has gone and the milk sugar caramelises.
The brown mass is packed and refrigerated.

sources.text: Wikipedia for whey with cream boiled down for hours, the browning of milk sugar and the original fløtemysost that was boiled to under 80 % of its liquid. It gives no temperatures or fat figures.
